decision: Add a Class B dispatch route for swallowed_exception (broad/bare except silently passing) limited to scripts/** and src/gaia_cli/** with AST exception proof and focused test verification?
whyItMatters: 42 open swallowed_exception debts exist across scripts and CLI. Silent exception swallowing conceals unexpected bugs while intentional best-effort fallbacks lack explicit documented intent markers.
evidence: Founder directive (verbatim, 2026-11-08): "Ok walk me through why this is not repairable. Whats the point of it being class B if there is no repair route. Its the job of the agents to find one."

Founder Ruling 4 (2026-11-08, steward-class-b-route-authority-2283): standing authority granted for routine, demonstrably safe Class B routes upon independent acceptance by a terra reviewer. Safeguards require preserving error-handling semantics, safe diagnostics, and focused behavioral tests.

Root-Cause Plan §4 and §11 Move 4: handlers that feed authorization, budget/spend recording, file overwrite, or mutation decisions cannot be resolved with a best-effort marker and must be escalated to engineering; gaia_cli.structuredRead (PR #2376) provides canonical bestEffort loader swaps.

Mechanical proof in exceptionproof.py guarantees diffs touch strictly except clauses, preserves exception variable bindings, verifies pure diagnostic arguments, and rejects best-effort markers in escalated security contexts.

Independent adversarial Terra review completed on 2026-11-08 with ACCEPT verdict, verifying AST structural checks for sensitive identifiers and dev mutations, line-number-independent escalation in _assert_route_eligible, and strict module-scope import provenance.
recommended: Option A: author bounded Class B route swallowed-exception-repair with mechanical AST proof, confined to subject file, requiring py_compile and focused pytest.
alternative: Leave all 42 files to manual refactoring and keep swallowed_exception unrouted.
unblocks: Closure of up to 42 swallowed_exception debts across scripts and gaia_cli.
